name: Ginger, Queen of Sweets
oracle_text:
When Ginger enters, you become the monarch.
{2}, {T}, Sacrifice Ginger: You gain 6 life.
At the beginning of each upkeep, if you're the monarch, create a Gingerbrute token. (It's a {1} 1/1 Food Golem artifact creature with haste, "{1}: This token can't be blocked this turn except by creatures with haste," and "{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this token: You gain 3 life.")

needs.what: a one-shot, turn-scoped evasion for the Gingerbrute token's "{1}: This token can't be blocked this turn except by creatures with haste." -- the `unblockable` op (or a sibling) with a blocker exemption filter, here `{"keywords": ["haste"]}`, read from the blocker's derived characteristics in `combat.can_block` and ending at cleanup.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `unblockable` stops every block, which is strictly better than printed; the `block_restriction` static ("can't be blocked except by ...") lasts as long as its permanent and its `condition` vocabulary (static conditions) cannot read `has_turn_flag`, so a `set_turn_flag` activation cannot switch it on for one turn; `grant_ability` cannot carry a static (characteristics._battlefield_statics never reads granted abilities); no keyword means "can't be blocked except by creatures with haste" (horsemanship and shadow are the nearest exemption-shaped evasions)

needs.what: a Gingerbrute token: a colorless 1/1 Food Golem artifact creature token with haste and mana cost {1} ("This token's mana cost is {1}"), "{1}: This token can't be blocked this turn except by creatures with haste." and "{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this token: You gain 3 life." -- a Tier 0 entry once unblockable_except exists, and not before: its first ability is the missing op
